Name: Immersive Shops - Pierre's
Author: donko526
Description:
"Immersive Shops - Pierre's" is a Content Patcher pack that aims to add visual variety to Pierre's General Store by changing the contents of the store's shelves depending on the season and how many days you've played.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9127/9127-1714756956-2083501584.gif[/img]

Prior to SDV 1.6, this mod used to add the ability to purchase items from the store shelves. This feature will return at a later date.

All assets were created by me, either from scratch or from rehashing existing vanilla sprites.

This page will get gussied up soon :)

Downloads.Description:
Updated to SDV 1.6.

No longer dependent on ShopTileFramework.

Removed the recolor templates, will replace later.

Removed the ability to buy items from shelves, this will be making a return later.

Removed the PPJA shelves as PPJA is very out of date.

Manifest.Name: Immersive Shops - Pierre's
Manifest.Description: Adds cosmetic changes to Pierre's shop depending on days played and the current season.
